title: Prompt Versioning

definition: Prompt Versioning is a core concept in Prompt Engineering. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Prompt Versioning is
theory.body: Prompt Versioning describes the methods and patterns used within Prompt Engineering to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Prompt Versioning is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Prompt Versioning matters
theory.body: Without Prompt Versioning, systems built with Prompt Engineering are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Prompt Versioning works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Prompt Versioning follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Prompt Versioning.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Prompt Versioning
theory.body: Prompt Versioning offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
